cohort: 66 pregnant women with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) and 93 healthy age-matched pregnant controls
finding: Higher SLEDAI-2K (> 4) before conception was independently associated with a 4.87 times higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes in women with SLE.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were statistically significantly higher in pregnant women with SLE compared to healthy controls.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was statistically significantly higher in SLE patients than in healthy controls.
